retainedOriginalStatement.text: Fixes #1074. A malformed pie slice can be reported one or more lines above its authored location because Archify's legend normalization consumes line breaks in `showData`, slice whitespace and blank tails. Preserve the consumed CR/LF characters while retaining the accepted multiline slice normalization, so both the diagnostic line and its message identify the actual bad line.
